vulgate.note: Clementine includes the Jesse–David clause in Matthew 1:5; Douay–Rheims places its English at the start of 1:6. Follow source aligns that published English with the Latin here. Translation order preserves the complete published English verse 1:5.

The first English sentence in Douay–Rheims 1:6 belongs with the Latin ending of Clementine 1:5. Follow source uses the remaining published English beside the Latin here. Translation order preserves the complete published English verse 1:6.
